_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
# Smart Cuff v3.1.364 — Default

Smart Const and High Max now calculate the PVR target on the Arduino after
deflation, using the cuff oscillation-envelope peak. High Max keeps its initial
200 mmHg inflation and replaces the fixed 100 mmHg PVR target with this estimate.

- Smart Const: accept peaks from 30 through 140 mmHg; cap the PVR target at 130.
- High Max: use accepted peaks from 30 through 140 mmHg directly.
- Rejected estimates: use 80 mmHg. Refill and quiet hold use the same final target,
  with no +5 mmHg or arterial-MAP bias correction.
- The GUI and standalone presets share the firmware runner. The GUI validates
  each cycle's target and stops if the report is missing or inconsistent.

The estimator uses forward/backward 0.5–5 Hz Butterworth filtering (fourth-order
prototype), pulse harmonics, wide-window SNR and two joined Gaussian halves.
SNR must pass 5 dB; supported measured-crest recovery requires above 7 dB.
The OLED and GUI distinguish analysis, accepted target and fallback.

The faster embedded variant took about 24 seconds on a typical synthetic pulse,
31 seconds for 50 bpm with a 135 mmHg peak, and 43 seconds at 30 bpm. Analysis
keeps the pump off and services STOP and existing pressure protection. A
60-second computation timeout returns 80; STOP or a safety fault aborts without
refill. Capture now runs in the existing 50 Hz ADC interrupt.
Cadence scratch storage also saves 1.8 KB of stack without changing any replay
result or increasing the static workspace.

Host replay accepted 2,704 of 3,024 retained intervals. Compared with native-rate
offline analysis, 22 became accepted and 44 became rejected; the median paired
absolute peak difference was 0.535 mmHg. Four known wrong acceptances remain in
the 96-case artifact suite, all with interference near the cardiac rate.

Device C was flashed through the protected snapshot/restore transaction; its
calibration, valve limits, feedforward and PID values were verified afterward.
The uploader now compiles before entering the bootloader, so build failures
cannot erase the running firmware. GUI suites, layout/smoke checks, numerical
replay, target validation and STOP tests passed.

The final seed-213 soak completed six cycles across all five presets with no
flags: 29,331/29,331 telemetry frames (100%). All six deflations passed the
actuator-reversal gate. Steady-band rates were 3.73 and 3.59 mmHg/s for Smart
Const, 3.58 for Regular and 3.59 for High Max (command 4); whole-descent CVP
rates were 0.88 for Arm and 0.96 for Wrist (command 1). The control scorers now
recognize direct deflation starts and exclude the subsequent analysis pause.
Final GUI/firmware START runs also passed: Smart Const 5,718/5,718 frames and
High Max 5,665/5,665 frames, both with the expected 80 mmHg fallback.

This update is for the requested bench evaluation. The operator confirmed the
ProSim pneumatic connection needs changing. Runs without that connection test
fallback and pressure control; accepted-peak operation still needs physical
pulsatile testing after reconnection. Pressure-only SNR cannot exclude every
movement artifact, and this release does not establish clinical accuracy.
One earlier High Max run stopped on a malformed serial result; the guard
refused it. A subsequent idle link probe and complete repeat passed. The failed
run is retained; an intermittent transport fault has not been proven resolved.

The installer is unsigned. On a first installation, choose **More info → Run
anyway** if Windows SmartScreen appears. Existing Default installations set to
Latest use the verified automatic update path.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
